packages.name: snapback4
packages.description: Snapback 4 — the binary: check, dev, run, test, why, guide, doctor, init.

packages.name: snapback4-core
packages.description: Snapback 4 core: the value model, schema, IR, SQLite store, rules, the runtime meter, the interpreter, and the partition log (LLP 3000 §5 week 2).

packages.name: snapback4-lang
packages.description: Quarry for Snapback 4: lexer, parser, binder to the core IR, diagnostics with rewrites, and the client type emitter.

packages.name: snapback4-device
packages.description: Snapback 4 on a device: one implementation of the device — the partition held, the stream applied, the outbox kept, queries and predictions answered — over the core's SQLite on a native host (`native`, with a C ABI) or over memory as wasm on the web (`web`).

packages.name: snapback4-native
packages.description: The guest side of a Snapback 4 native job (LLP 3000.005): the app's own Rust, compiled to wasm, reading and writing the store through the engine's own operations under the job's meter.

packages.name: snapback4-sim
packages.description: Deterministic simulation for Snapback 4: one program under a seed — virtual clock, scheduler, faulty network, faulty disks, kill and restart — hosting the real server core and a replica client.
